card.name: Inside dose numbers and units
card.fires_on: Partway through dose expressions in dosing sections, such as the digit before a decimal point, the m after mg/, or mg after a number. It also appears on some split medical words in the same sections.

modes.label: Numbers and units in doses
modes.description: Digits, decimals and unit pieces within an amount per day or per kg.
